latest.notes: Videos on the phone now browses series with seasons, subtitles, up-next autoplay, playback speed and cast, works offline with saved progress and without a valid session, and estimates download sizes.

releases.notes: Videos on the phone now browses series with seasons, subtitles, up-next autoplay, playback speed and cast, works offline with saved progress and without a valid session, and estimates download sizes.
System: a core update now restarts in seconds instead of being hard-killed after 90 s, and no longer reports interrupted downloads
Music: playlist downloads run four at a time (setting 1/2/4/6), roughly twice as fast
Books: an installable phone app at /books with background audiobooks and offline EPUB/PDF downloads
Music: every playlist shows how many tracks are already downloaded to the phone
Videos: new 480p · tiny download version, now the default — plus working delete for active downloads, no poster flicker and no lingering Tasks row.
Music: Polubione is a normal playlist (liked tracks download to the phone) and downloads resync when the app returns to the foreground
Videos: Select many films at once (phone and desktop) and download them in one go using your default version.
Music: the phone player is now the installable /music web app with offline playlist downloads; the Android APK is retired

Videos: queue many downloads, choose Original/1080p/720p (default in Settings) and the NAS prepares them one by one — the queue survives a reload and Original copies the video instead of re-encoding it.
Videos: a clear HTTPS notice when a phone tries to download over a plain-http address
Videos: install the /videos web app on your phone — full library, fullscreen player and offline downloads that work without the NAS
Sticky Notes: checklist tasks, a right-edge quick-capture ribbon and an installable /notes app with offline queue and Web Push reminders.
Sharing: grant files, Photos albums, Video folders and Music playlists view-only to other accounts; Files drops Favorites that point at deleted folders.

Playback in every browser: the player negotiates the audio codec with the server (AAC, Opus, or video-only with a notice) and always uses hls.js when Media Source is available, so Safari/Android Chrome stop failing on the bounded live window.

Movies with Dolby Digital Plus 5.1(side) audio (WEB-DL rips) play again: AAC is normalised to a standard 5.1/7.1 layout so Chrome accepts the stream. The player logs the real error, retries once and shows the reason; a crashed encoder is logged with its ffmpeg stderr.
Video Station: 10-bit HEVC playback fix (VA-API nv12) and automatic software HLS fallback.
Video Station: keyless metadata via Cinemeta/TVmaze, optional TMDB, provider picker and cache migration; File Manager archive extraction.
Desktop: right-click menus stay inside the window, with wrapped labels on narrow screens.
Tasks: OS updates keep a single progress row that finishes even when you leave Settings.
Files: Enter now confirms New Folder, New File and other dialogs instead of dismissing them.
Packages: cleaner catalog cards, pill filters and working action buttons; uninstall now completes cleanly.
Download Manager: Resume repairs tasks queued under an old, unwritable download folder
Video Station: HLS playback with VA-API hardware decode/encode, cinema UI 2.0 and mobile parity.
EthOS OS: A/B image updates — check, download, install to the standby slot, reboot or automatic rollback
